Name: CP - PokeCrops
Author: Meowdoleon
Description:
Since Egg stopped working on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1614]PokeCrops[/url], I decided to port it to Json Asset back in 2018.
Since then, I made some new berries over the years to add some variety to make it less "yet another crop mod", and even added compatibility to both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15737]EBAGI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]AHM[/url].
There was one feature that was requested many times over the years however, and it is finally here: a Content Patcher version.

A big thank you to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/messenger/5881490/#][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/vikich3rry][b]vikich3rry[/b][/url][color=#ffffff],[/color][color=#ffffff] who made a Content Patcher version for themselves and graciously shared it with me so that I could learn from it. That definitely helped speed along my Content Patcher learning process.[/color]

Without further ado, the mod itself.

[size=4]Original Egg's berries[size=4]:[/size][/size]
[list]
[*]Aspear Berry: Fall crop that takes 13 days to grow. Similar to Cauliflower, but is a fall fruit instead.[/*]
[*]Chesto Berry: Cheaper Aspear Berries. (Might redesign)[/*]
[*]Leppa Berry: Pricier Aspear Berries. (Might redesign)[/*]
[*]Cheri Berry: Spring crop that takes 13 days to grow. Cauliflower, but as a fruit. (Might redesign)[/*]
[*]Lum Berry: Spring and Summer crop that takes 15 days to grow.[/*]
[*]Oran Berry: Summer and Fall crop that takes 15 days to grow.[/*]
[*]Pecha Berry: Summer crop that takes 10 days to grow.[/*]
[*]Persim Berry: Fall crop that takes 15 days to grow.[/*]
[*]Rawst Berry: Spring crop that takes 13 days to grow.[/*]
[*]Sitrus Berry: Fall crop that takes 9 days to grow.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]1.0.1 berry:[/size]
[list]
[*]Nanab Berry: Summer crop that takes 11 day to grow.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]1.1 berries:[/size]
[list]
[*]Razz Berry: Plant in Winter, harvest in Spring. Higher return on investment than other berries due to its long growing cycle. Note that while it is possible to plant them in Spring, they will die when summer comes before they can be harvested.[/*]
[*]Bluk Berry: Plant in any season (not available for sale in Spring). Very long growing cycle. Infinite yearly regrow. Higher return on investment than the Razz Berry. (Might be buggy. Please report any pain points or bug.)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]2.0 changes:[/size]
[list]
[*]Added color tags: No need for EBAGI anymore for basic custom artisan craft colors. (EBAGI is still recommended to have more complex and handcrafted artisan goods icons)[/*]
[*]Bluk Berry is now an end-game item, purchasable in any season, except Spring, at Qi's Gem Shop.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Installation:[/size]
[size=4]Vanilla SMAPI:[/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Install[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2065] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720][/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Unzip "[JA] PokeCrops" folder in your "Mods" folder[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Stardrop:[/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url][/*]
[*]Install ﻿[url=http:][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] through Stardrop[/*]
[*]Unzip "[JA] PokeCrops" folder in your Stardrop Installed Mods folder, or drag and drop the zipped file into the Stardrop application[/*]
[*]Activate [JA] PokeCrops in Stardrop[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Animal Husbandry:[/size]
I made a patch for Animal Husbandry to be able to give the berries as a treat to vanilla animals.
Note that they won't eat all berries. I made them able to eat what they are able to in real life, for the most part. I did remove some very repetitive one on some of them when they don't absolutely love it (Pear, Apple and Berries are very recurrent) for balance purpose, based the pet diet on the cat, as it is the pet with the most restrictions compared to dogs, and the Dino can eat the lesser used berries.

Simply unarchive the patch into the Animal Husbandry Mod folder. This is a temporary solution until a cleaner way to modify vanilla animals that does not use Harmony is found.
This sadly means that, in the meantime, this won't be Stardrop friendly.
If you use Stardrop, locate your folder of AHM by right-clicking on the entry in Stardrop -> Open... -> Open Containing Folder.
